s: Din tiqqune hattepillin vedine haretzuot ubo v' seipim: im niqreu mechitztzot happenimiyyot shebben bayit lebayit bitpillin shel rosh umibbachutz kullan qayyamin ushelemim, im hem chadashim — kesherim bekol inyan (ella im ken niqreu shelosha battim beinyan zeh), veim hem yeshanim — pesulim, apillu lo niqreu ella shene battim, vaapillu yesh mechitztza shelema benehem, ella shenniqreu bazeh mechitztza shel tzad yamin ubazeh mechitztza shel tzad semol. Abal im yesh benehem bayit echad shalem, dehaynu shette mechitztzot shelemot — kesherim apillu hem yeshanim, ubilbad shello niqreu shelosha battim, dehaynu kol shalosh mechitztzot hannisharot. Veyesh omerim lehepek, shechadashim geruim mishanim, shekkevan shebbizman muat niqreu kol-kak — bevadday or mequlqal hu meiqqaro. Veyesh lehachamir kedibre shenehem:

Yesh mi sheomer shehu haddin battepirot, im nipsequ shette tepirot zo betzad zo, o shalosh apillu zo shello keneged zo — pesulim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishanim, abal bachadashim kol zeman sheor moshab habbattim qayyam — kesherim. Veellu hem chadashim: kol sheochazin miqtzat haor shenniqra tipro vetolin bo hattepillin vehu chazaq veeno nipsaq, abal im eno rauy litlot bo ella hu nipsaq — hare ellu yeshanim. Uledibre haomerim shechadashim geruim mishanim leinyan niqreu habbattim — hu haddin shehem geruim leinyan nipsequ hattepirot. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem, gam benipsequ hattepirot, lehachamir bachadashim kemo bishanim, apillu beshennipsequ shenayim zo betzad zo, ap al pi sheyyesh meqillin bazeh legamre ben bachadashim ben bishanim. Abal beshennipsequ shalosh apillu zo shello betzad zo — hem pesulim ledibre hakkol. Ubemaqom shei epshar limtzo tepillin acherim velo lachazor velitpor tepillin ellu — yesh lismok al hamqillin benipsequ shette tepirot zo betzad zo ben bachadashim ben bishanim, shello lehitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin:

Or haretzuot — tzarik lihyot mibbehema o chayya hattehorim, shello huksheru limleket shamayim ella tehorim bilbad. Vetzarik sheyyehe meubbad lishmo, veim lav — pasul ledibre hakkol, vaapillu lehammakshirim babbattim. Veyakol laasotan apillu miqqelap, kemo shennitbaer besiman lab:

Halaka lemosheh missinay sheyyihyu haretzuot shechorot mibbachutz, abal mitztzad penim yaaseh meezo tzeba sheyyirtzeh, chutz meadom shehu genay, shello yomru shemmiddam chatatayv nitzbeu veheeddimu. Abal habbattim en tzarik lihyot shechorot ella mishshum noy mitzva velo mehalaka lemosheh missinay, kemo shennitbaer besiman lab:

Vekevan shertzuot shechorot halaka lemosheh missinay — tzarik sheyyashchiren yisrael lishman, velo nokri. Vaapillu bediabad pesulot al yede nokri, ella al derek shennitbaer besiman lab beibbud. Veyesh mi sheomer sheyyesh lahen taqqana sheyyachazor veyashchiren yisrael lishman. Vetob lehachamir. Abal im hannokri hishchir et habbattim — kesherim, shehare apillu lo hishchiran kelal — kesherin. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob sheyyashchiren yisrael lishman, kemo haretzuot:

Retzua shennipseqa — en lah taqqana lo biqshira velo bitpira, shenneemar: "uqeshartam", vedareshu raza"l: qesher tam, dehaynu haretzua sheqqosher bah hattepillin — tihyeh tamma ushelema, velo qeshura o tepura. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennipsequ tok shiuran, dehaynu beshel rosh ad hattabbur mitztzad yamin vead hechazeh mitztzad semol, ubeshel yad ad kede shettaqqip hazzeroa liqshor hattepilla im hazzeroa, ukede shettimmatach ad etzba emtzait veyikrok mimmenna al otah etzba shalosh kerikot veyiqshor, abal kol yitron haorek shehi bishbil shekkorek haretzua kamma peamim sebib hayyad — en haqqeshira vehattepira poselin bo. Veyesh omerim sheen qeshira utepira poselet bo ella bemah shemmaqqip harosh bilbad, o bemah shemmaqqip hazzeroa liqshor hattepilla im hazzeroa, shekkesheyyesh sham qesher o teper — en haqqesher shel rosh o shel yad niqra qeshira tamma, abal bemah shettaluy min harosh ad hechazeh vehattabbur, veken bemah shennimtach mehazzeroa ad etzba emtzait — moelet bah qeshira o tepira. Veyesh meqillim od sheapillu bemah shemmaqqip harosh vehazzeroa — moelet tepira keshettoperan mitztzad penim, shello yihyeh hatteper nireh mibbachutz utehe niret kishlema, vehu sheyyitperenna begidim kesherim. Veyesh meqillin apillu bechutim. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir (beshel tora) kassebara harishona bemaqom sheepshar. Veap sheyyesh lehaqel litpor mibbipnim bemah shettaluy min harosh, hoil veyesh mattirim apillu bemah shemmaqqip harosh, mikkol maqom qasheh lizzaher shello tehe hattepira niret kelal mibbachutz. Abal bishat haddechaq — yesh lismok al dibre hammeqillin yoter, kede shello yitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin. Umikkol maqom — lo yebarek, shebberakot enan meakkebot:
